blocks.goal: Extract the parser configuration-related API (legacy deprecated pass-throughs that delegate to ParserConfig) into a new, cohesive helper class to reduce the number of public methods on Parser and concentrate configuration responsibilities.

expected_impact.rationale: Moves 11 deprecated configuration-related public methods out of Parser into a new ParserConfigSupport class. Parser will gain a single accessor to obtain the new helper, yielding a net reduction in Parser's public method count and a medium reduction of Parser's LOC and complexity because many small getters/setters are removed.

ops.details: Create a new class org.jsoup.parser.ParserConfigSupport that encapsulates the legacy configuration passthroughs currently on Parser. The new class will hold a reference to the existing ParserConfig and expose the moved operations. The following public methods are removed from Parser and moved to ParserConfigSupport (delegating to ParserConfig): isTrackErrors(), setTrackErrors(int), getErrors(), isTrackPosition(), setTrackPosition(boolean), settings(ParseSettings), settings(), setMaxDepth(int), getMaxDepth(), tagSet(TagSet), tagSet(). Parser is updated to remove these methods and to add a single accessor method public ParserConfigSupport configSupport() { return new ParserConfigSupport(this.config); } so callers can obtain the configuration helper. The moved methods on ParserConfigSupport will return types appropriate for the extracted responsibility (setter chaining returns ParserConfigSupport) and delegate directly to ParserConfig. No other Parser behavior is changed. This concentrates configuration responsibilities into a single class, reducing Parser's public API surface.
Move public boolean isTrackErrors() from Parser to ParserConfigSupport and implement by delegating to ParserConfig.isTrackErrors(). Removed from Parser.

Move public Parser setTrackErrors(int) to ParserConfigSupport; on the extracted class the method becomes public ParserConfigSupport setTrackErrors(int) delegating to ParserConfig.setTrackErrors(int) and returning this for chaining. Removed from Parser.
Move public ParseErrorList getErrors() to ParserConfigSupport and delegate to ParserConfig.getErrors(). Removed from Parser.
Move public boolean isTrackPosition() to ParserConfigSupport and delegate to ParserConfig.isTrackPosition(). Removed from Parser.
Move public Parser setTrackPosition(boolean) to ParserConfigSupport and make it return ParserConfigSupport for chaining; delegate to ParserConfig.setTrackPosition(boolean). Removed from Parser.
Move public Parser settings(ParseSettings) to ParserConfigSupport and make it return ParserConfigSupport; delegate to ParserConfig.settings(ParseSettings). Removed from Parser.
Move public ParseSettings settings() to ParserConfigSupport and delegate to ParserConfig.settings(). Removed from Parser.
Move public Parser setMaxDepth(int) to ParserConfigSupport and make it return ParserConfigSupport; delegate to ParserConfig.setMaxDepth(int). Removed from Parser.
Move public int getMaxDepth() to ParserConfigSupport and delegate to ParserConfig.getMaxDepth(). Removed from Parser.
Move public Parser tagSet(TagSet) to ParserConfigSupport and make it return ParserConfigSupport; delegate to ParserConfig.tagSet(TagSet). Removed from Parser.
Move public TagSet tagSet() to ParserConfigSupport and delegate to ParserConfig.tagSet(). Removed from Parser.
